rules.conditional_format: Ligue 2 4th v 5th, winner v 3rd; survivor v Ligue 1 16th over two legs
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Ligue 1 bottom two down; 16th keeps place if it wins promotion/relegation tie. Play-off pathway is NOT one guaranteed additional transfer.

rules.conditional_format: Ligue 3 3rd-6th play-off winner v Ligue 2 16th over two legs
rules.league_specific_exceptions: New professional Ligue 3 starts 2026/27; use this exact tier-3 league, not the former National name. Bottom Ligue 2 places 17th and 18th down; 16th enters tie.

rules.conditional_format: Challenger Pro League 2026/27 is 15 clubs: champion promoted; 2nd-5th two-legged semi-finals and final for second promotion
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Both Jupiler Pro League bottom clubs relegated directly; no promotion/relegation tie against top tier. U23 quota protection was withdrawn for 2026/27; lower division has its own 14th-15th relegation.

rules.conditional_format: Championship 2nd-4th progressive two-leg playoff, winner faces Premiership 11th in final; 12th directly relegated
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Premiership has post-33-game split, 38 total. Play-off structure crosschecked against SPFL published playoff fixtures; 2026/27 final scheduled May 20/23. Licensed promotion eligibility must still be reviewed.

rules.conditional_format: Eredivisie 16th plays promotion/relegation playoffs against eligible Eerste Divisie qualifiers; 17th and 18th relegated
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Eerste Divisie period winner and club eligibility rules are important; youth/reserve sides may be ineligible for promotion. The exact bracket needs cross-check against the KNVB published 2026/27 playoff regulation.

rules.conditional_format: Primeira Liga 16th v Liga Portugal 2 3rd; two-legged tie, 17th/18th relegated
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Source names 2026/27 playoff pairing and first/second leg order. Professional eligibility still separate.

rules.conditional_format: Super League 11th v Challenge League 2nd, two-legged barrage; 12th direct relegation
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Super League splits into Championship and Relegation groups after matchday 33. Conditional barrage dated 1/4 June 2027.

rules.conditional_format: Serie B 3rd-8th contend for third promotion unless bypassed by season regulation; Serie A 18th-20th demoted
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Serie B additional conditional third-direct-promotion points-gap trigger must be confirmed in official 2026/27 FIGC or Lega B rules before gameplay activation.

rules.conditional_format: Champion with Bundesliga licence promotes and 12th relegates. If champion lacks licence, a licensed 2nd-4th club may face 12th in two-legged tie; if none eligible there is no movement
rules.league_specific_exceptions: Mutually exclusive promotion paths: direct one-for-one swap OR conditional inter-division tie OR zero. Do not sum 1+1 slots and relegate two automatically.
